integrity: The complete standalone code deterministically enumerates the graph, 33 perfect matchings, minimum feedback arc sets, all 96 automorphisms, and cycle-packing witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for GP(8,3) only; cannot infer a general nonplanar result. The 2025 matching-polynomial paper was only partially accessible. No external independent audit.
title: Anti-forcing spectrum and two-factor types of the Möbius–Kantor graph
